results.query: Create a day-by-day schedule and recommend restaurants for each day.
results.description: Planning with discovery — itinerary plus restaurant recommendations.
results.response_text:
I've got a day-by-day schedule for you in Paris, along with some great restaurant recommendations. 

On day 1, you'll visit Point zéro des routes de France and explore Notre Dame, then take a sunset walk at Pont au Double. For dinner, consider Uno or Chez Denise. 

Day 2 takes you to the Archeological crypt of the île de la Cité and Église Saint-Jean-le-Rond de Paris, with dinner at Le Comptoir du Relais. 

Day 3 is all about Sainte-Geneviève-des-Ardents and Palais épiscopal de Paris, followed by a river cruise on the Seine. You could grab dinner at Le Petit Marché or Café des Musées.

The rest of the week is just as exciting, with visits to Chapelle Saint-Christophe de Paris, Ancienne cathédrale Saint-Étienne de Paris, and Cathédrale primitive Notre-Dame de Paris. Be sure to try Le Grand Vefour or La Robe et le Palais for dinner on day 4. 

For the last few days, you've got Église Sainte-Marine, Pont Saint-Charles, and another visit to Point zéro des routes de France and Notre Dame. Don't miss dinner at Le Petit Châtelet or 404. 

Enjoy your time in Paris, and don't hesitate to reach out if you need more recommendations or have any questions!

judge_scores.reasoning: The response directly addresses the user's query by providing a day-by-day schedule and recommending restaurants for each day. It covers various aspects of the query, including activities and dining options. However, it could be improved by providing more detailed information about each location and restaurant, such as opening hours, prices, and dress code. Overall, the response is very helpful and provides actionable recommendations for a real traveler.
